subject.title: Automatic git worktree management for agent tasks

question: Should OpenClaw core own automatic managed git worktree creation, provisioning, cleanup, restore, and Workboard materialization through the linked implementation PR, or should the work be narrowed/split first?
rationale: The current source gap is clear, but the proposed solution creates new core lifecycle, protocol, SDK, UI, state, and repo-hook execution surfaces that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review linked core PR after fixes
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate, but require the existing blockers and security/upgrade concerns to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Split the design first
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking for smaller staged PRs that separate the core service, Workboard materialization, Control UI, and SDK/API exposure.

options.title: Defer core ownership
options.body: Pause or close the linked PR if maintainers decide managed worktrees should live outside core or wait for a narrower plugin/API design.

recommendation.title: Review linked core PR after fixes
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate, but require the existing blockers and security/upgrade concerns to be resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current Workboard workspace surface in main and owns the linked implementation candidate.
